answer: Saffron-Ridge Harvest Proof: each identity tends one distinct saffron crocus bed on a registered terraced ridge plot — bulbs cost $25 and one gram needs 150 hand-picked flowers. A soil sensor on the plot pulses weekly moisture readings to the GI saffron registry, and at harvest the collection center weighs the crop and issues a receipt the verifier checks. A fake with no plot has no pulse and no receipt, and one bed cannot serve two identities.
